name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Tennessee - Jackson TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance off the public road on the south side; long access drive leads to a gatehouse with a barrier arm visible across the road in zoom-20 imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed gatehouse confirmed: a white security building set beside the entrance drive with a horizontal barrier-arm gate spanning the truck lane; trucks/trailers staged just inside.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Long paved access drive and apron outside the gatehouse give room for trucks to wait before the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep entrance approach off the public road can hold a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer parking / staging is modest for this casting plant — trailers parked along the building aprons and a small NE yard; band 10-25, estimate flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~12 dock doors estimated along the building's truck-side aprons; partly obscured by canopy structures — flagged as estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and generous paved width at the gatehouse leave room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One large interconnected casting-plant complex plus a few support structures (utility buildings, materials yard) — single operational facility.
fieldNotes.railServed: No active rail spur runs into the plant property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Large isolated industrial tract on the edge of Jackson, TN surrounded by farmland and woods — Rural per rubric, but a sizeable town is nearby so connectivity is fine.
